preconditions.description: The value of k must be between 0 and 10,000 inclusive.
The number of tickets m must be between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m lines.
Each line in the output must contain exactly 8 digits.
All tickets in the output must be distinct.
